Psalm 1.title: Psalm 1
Psalm 1.prayer: God of all blessing, plant us beside the streams of your living water, that we may delight in your law and bear fruit in due season; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Happy are they who have not walked in the counsel of the wicked, * nor lingered in the way of sinners, nor sat in the seats of the scornful!
Their delight is in the law of the Lord, * and on this law they meditate day and night.
They are like trees planted by streams of water, bearing fruit in due season, with leaves that do not wither; * everything they do shall prosper.
For the Lord knows the way of the righteous, * but the way of the wicked is doomed.

versesBAS.text: Happy are they who have not walked in the counsel of the wicked, * nor lingered in the way of sinners, nor sat in the seats of the scornful!

They are like trees planted by streams of water, bearing fruit in due season, with leaves that do not wither; * everything they do shall prosper.
For the Lord knows the way of the righteous, * but the way of the wicked is doomed.

versesCoverdale.text: Blessed is the man that hath not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, nor stood in the way of sinners : and hath not sat in the seat of the scornful.
But his delight is in the law of the Lord : and in his law will he exercise himself day and night.
And he shall be like a tree planted by the water-side : that will bring forth his fruit in due season.
For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous : but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

Psalm 2.title: Psalm 2
Psalm 2.prayer: Almighty God, ruler of the nations, establish the reign of your anointed Son throughout the earth, that all peoples may rejoice in your peace; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Why are the nations in an uproar? * Why do the peoples mutter empty threats?
Why do the rulers of the earth rise up in revolt, and the princes plot together, * against the Lord and against the Anointed One?
Let me announce the decree of the Lord, * who said to me, “You are my Chosen; this day have I begotten you.”
Serve the Lord with fear, * and with trembling bow before God; happy are all who take refuge in the Lord!

versesBAS.text: Why are the nations in an uproar? * Why do the peoples mutter empty threats?
Why do the kings of the earth rise up in revolt, and the princes plot together, * against the Lord and against his Anointed?
Let me announce the decree of the Lord: * he said to me, “You are my Son; this day have I begotten you.”
Serve the Lord with fear, * and with trembling kiss his feet; happy are all they who take refuge in him!

versesCoverdale.text: Why do the heathen so furiously rage together : and why do the people imagine a vain thing?
The kings of the earth stand up, and the rulers take counsel together : against the Lord, and against his Anointed.
I will preach the law, whereof the Lord hath said unto me : Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
Serve the Lord in fear : and rejoice unto him with reverence.

Psalm 3.title: Psalm 3
Psalm 3.prayer: Shield of your people and lifter of our heads, sustain us when we lie down and when we rise up, for deliverance belongs to you, O Lord our God. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Lord, how many adversaries I have! * how many there are who rise up against me!
But you, O Lord, are a shield about me; * you are my glory, thejai One who lifts up my head.
I call aloud upon the Lord, * who answers me from the holy hill;
I lie down and go to sleep; * I wake again, because the Lord sustains me.

versesBAS.text: Lord, how many adversaries I have! * how many there are who rise up against me!

I call aloud upon the Lord, * and he answers me from his holy hill;
I lie down and go to sleep; * I wake again, because the Lord sustains me.

versesCoverdale.text: Lord, how are they increased that trouble me : many are they that rise against me.
But thou, O Lord, art my defender : thou art my worship, and the lifter up of my head.
I did call upon the Lord with my voice : and he heard me out of his holy hill.
I laid me down and slept, and rose up again : for the Lord sustained me.

Psalm 4.title: Psalm 4
Psalm 4.prayer: Lord God of our salvation, hear us as we call upon you, and grant us a peaceful night, resting in your grace; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Answer me when I call, O God, defender of my cause; * you set me free when I am hard-pressed; have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
Know that the Lord does wonders for the faithful; * when I call upon the Lord, God will hear me.
Many are saying, “Oh, that we might see better times!” * Lift up the light of your countenance upon us, O Lord.
You have put gladness in my heart, * more than when grain and wine and oil increase.
I lie down in peace; at once I fall asleep; * for only you, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

versesCoverdale.text: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness : thou hast set me at liberty when I was in trouble; have mercy upon me, and hearken unto my prayer.
Know this also, that the Lord hath chosen to himself the man that is godly : when I call upon the Lord, he will hear me.
Lord, lift thou up : the light of thy countenance upon us.
Thou hast put gladness in my heart : since the time that their corn and wine and oil increased.
I will lay me down in peace, and take my rest : for it is thou, Lord, only, that makest me dwell in safety.

Psalm 5.title: Psalm 5
Psalm 5.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 5, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Give ear to my words, O Lord; * consider my meditation.
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

versesBAS.text: Give ear to my words, O Lord; * consider my meditation.

versesCoverdale.text: Ponder my words, O Lord : consider my meditation.

O deliver thy people, and bless thine inheritance : govern them, and lift them up for ever.

Psalm 6.title: Psalm 6
Psalm 6.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 6, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

Psalm 7.title: Psalm 7
Psalm 7.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 7, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: O Lord my God, I take refuge in you; * save and deliver me from all who pursue me.
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

Psalm 8.title: Psalm 8
Psalm 8.prayer: O Lord our Governor, how glorious is your name in all the world! Give us reverence for the work of your hands; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: O Lord our Governor, * how exalted is your name in all the world!
When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, * the moon and the stars you have set in their courses,
What are mortals that you should be mindful of them, * mere human beings that you should seek them out?
You have made them but little lower than the angels; * you adorn them with glory and honour;
O Lord our Governor, * how exalted is your name in all the world!

versesBAS.text: O Lord our Governor, * how exalted is your name in all the world!

What is man that you should be mindful of him? * the son of man that you should seek him out?
You have made him but little lower than the angels; * you adorn him with glory and honour;
O Lord our Governor, * how exalted is your name in all the world!

versesCoverdale.text: O Lord our Governour, how excellent is thy Name in all the world : thou that hast set thy glory above the heavens!
For I will consider thy heavens, even the works of thy fingers : the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained.
What is man, that thou art mindful of him : and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
Thou madest him lower than the angels : to crown him with glory and worship.
O Lord our Governour : how excellent is thy Name in all the world!

Psalm 9.title: Psalm 9
Psalm 9.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 9, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: I will give thanks to you, O Lord, with my whole heart; * I will tell of all your marvellous works.

Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

Psalm 10.title: Psalm 10
Psalm 10.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 10, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

Psalm 11.title: Psalm 11
Psalm 11.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 11, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: In the Lord have I taken refuge; * how then can you say to my soul, “Fly away like a bird to the hilltop”?
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

Psalm 12.title: Psalm 12
Psalm 12.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 12, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Help me, Lord, for there is no godly one left; * the faithful have vanished from among us.
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

versesCoverdale.text: Help me, Lord, for there is not one godly man left : for the faithful are minished from among the children of men.
For thy loving-kindness is ever before mine eyes : and I will walk in thy truth.
O deliver thy people, and bless thine inheritance : govern them, and lift them up for ever.

Psalm 13.title: Psalm 13
Psalm 13.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 13, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: How long, O Lord? will you forget me for ever? * how long will you hide your face from me?
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

Psalm 14.title: Psalm 14
Psalm 14.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 14, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Fools have said in their hearts, “There is no God.” * All are corrupt and commit abominable acts.
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

versesCoverdale.text: The fool hath said in his heart : There is no God.

Psalm 15.title: Psalm 15
Psalm 15.prayer: Lord God, lead us in integrity and truth, that we may dwell upon your holy hill and walk blamelessly before you; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Lord, who may dwell in your tabernacle? * who may abide upon your holy hill?
Whoever leads a blameless life and does what is right, * who speaks the truth from the heart.
There is no guile upon their tongue; they do no evil to their friend; * they do not heap contempt upon a neighbour.

versesBAS.text: Lord, who may dwell in your tabernacle? * who may abide upon your holy hill?
Whoever leads a blameless life and does what is right, * who speaks the truth from his heart.
There is no guile upon his tongue; he does no evil to his friend; * he does not heap contempt upon his neighbour.

versesCoverdale.text: Lord, who shall dwell in thy tabernacle : or who shall rest upon thy holy hill?
Even he that leadeth an uncorrupt life : and doeth the thing which is right, and speaketh the truth from his heart.
He that hath used no deceit in his tongue, nor done evil to his neighbour : and hath not slandered his neighbour.

Psalm 16.title: Psalm 16
Psalm 16.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 16, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Protect me, O God, for I take refuge in you; * I have said to the Lord, “You are my Lord, my good above all other.”
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

versesCoverdale.text: Preserve me, O God : for in thee have I put my trust.

Psalm 17.title: Psalm 17
Psalm 17.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 17, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Hear my plea of innocence, O Lord; give heed to my cry; * listen to my prayer, which does not come from lying lips.
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

versesCoverdale.text: Hear the right, O Lord, consider my complaint : and hearken unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
For thy loving-kindness is ever before mine eyes : and I will walk in thy truth.

Psalm 18.title: Psalm 18
Psalm 18.prayer: O God, our strength and salvation, you hear the cries of your humble people; deliver us from every snare and lead us into your glorious light; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: I love you, O Lord my strength, * O Lord my stronghold, my crag, and my haven.
My God, my rock in whom I put my trust, * my shield, the horn of my salvation, and my refuge; you are worthy of praise.
In my distress I called upon the Lord * and cried out to my God for help.
God reached down from on high and grasped me; * and drew me out of great waters.
God brought me out into an open place * and rescued me, because of great delight in me.

versesBAS.text: I love you, O Lord my strength, * O Lord my stronghold, my crag, and my haven.

In my anguish I called upon the Lord * and cried out to my God for help.
He reached down from on high and grasped me; * he drew me out of great waters.
He brought me forth into an open place; * he rescued me, because he delighted in me.

versesCoverdale.text: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength; the Lord is my stony rock, and my defence : my saviour, my God, and my might, in whom I will trust.
I will call upon the Lord, which is worthy to be praised : so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
So shall he hear my voice out of his holy temple : and my complaint shall come before him, it shall enter even into his ears.
He shall send down from on high to fetch me : and shall take me out of many waters.
He brought me forth also into a place of liberty : he brought me forth, even because he had a favour unto me.

Psalm 19.title: Psalm 19
Psalm 19.prayer: Creator God, the heavens declare your glory and your law revives the soul; may the words of our mouths and the meditation of our hearts be acceptable in your sight, O Lord, our strength and our redeemer. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: The heavens declare the glory of God, * and the firmament shows the handiwork of the Lord.
The law of the Lord is perfect and revives the soul; * the testimony of the Lord is sure and gives wisdom to the innocent.
The statutes of the Lord are just and rejoice the heart; * the commandment of the Lord is clear and gives light to the eyes.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, * O Lord, my strength and my redeemer.

versesBAS.text: The heavens declare the glory of God, * and the firmament shows his handiwork.

Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, * O Lord, my strength and my redeemer.

versesCoverdale.text: The heavens declare the glory of God : and the firmament sheweth his handy-work.
The law of the Lord is an undefiled law, converting the soul : the testimony of the Lord is sure, and giveth wisdom unto the simple.
The statutes of the Lord are right, and rejoice the heart : the commandment of the Lord is pure, and giveth light unto the eyes.
Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart : be alway acceptable in thy sight, O Lord, my strength, and my redeemer.

Psalm 20.title: Psalm 20
Psalm 20.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 20, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: May the Lord answer you in the day of trouble, * the name of the God of Jacob defend you;
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

Psalm 21.title: Psalm 21
Psalm 21.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 21, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: The Sovereign rejoices in your strength, O Lord; * how greatly holding fast to your victory!

Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

Psalm 22.title: Psalm 22
Psalm 22.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 22, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? * and are so far from my cry and from the words of my distress?
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

versesCoverdale.text: My God, my God, look upon me; why hast thou forsaken me : and art so far from my health, and from the words of my complaint?
For thy loving-kindness is ever before mine eyes : and I will walk in thy truth.
O deliver thy people, and bless thine inheritance : govern them, and lift them up for ever.

Psalm 23.title: Psalm 23
Psalm 23.prayer: Lord Jesus Christ, good Shepherd of the sheep, you lead us beside still waters and restore our souls; abide with us through every shadow, and bring us to dwell in your house for ever. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: The Lord is my shepherd; * I shall not be in want.
You make me lie down in green pastures * and lead me beside still waters.
You revive my soul * and guide me along right pathways for your name’s sake.
Though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I shall fear no evil; * for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
Surely your goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life, * and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.

Psalm 75.title: Psalm 75
Psalm 75.prayer: Sovereign God, judge of all the earth, humble the pride of the arrogant and lift up the lowly by your righteous power; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: We give you thanks, O God, we give you thanks, * calling upon your name and declaring all your wonderful deeds.
“I will appoint a time,” says God; * “I will judge with equity.”
Though the earth and all its inhabitants are quaking, * I will make its pillars fast.
For God is the judge; * putting down one and lifting up another.

For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west : nor yet from the south. And why? God is the Judge : he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

Psalm 76.title: Psalm 76
Psalm 76.prayer: God of peace and majesty, break the weapons of war and establish your dwelling place in peace among all nations; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: In Judah is God known; * great is the divine name in Israel.
At Salem is the tabernacle of God, * and the dwelling-place of the Lord is in Zion.
There God broke the flashing arrows of the bow, * the shield, the sword, and the weapons of battle.
How glorious you are! * more splendid than the everlasting mountains!

Psalm 77.title: Psalm 77
Psalm 77.prayer: Redeeming God, whose way is in the sea and whose paths are in the great waters, lead your people like a flock by your steadfast love; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: I will cry aloud to God; * I will cry aloud, and God will hear me.
In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord; * by night my hand was stretched out and did not tire; my soul refused comfort.
I will remember the works of the Lord, * and call to mind your wonders of old time.
Your way, O God, is holy; * who is so great a god as our God?
You led your people like a flock * by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

Thou leddest thy people like sheep : by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

Psalm 78.title: Psalm 78
Psalm 78.prayer: Faithful God, you fed your people with the bread of heaven and guided them through the wilderness; teach us to recount your glorious deeds to every generation; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Hear my teaching, O my people; * incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
I will open my mouth in a parable; * I will declare the mysteries of ancient times.
We will not hide them from their children; * we will recount to generations to come the praiseworthy deeds and the power of the Lord,
In the daytime God led them with a cloud, * and all the night through with a glow of fire.
God split the hard rocks in the wilderness * and gave them drink as from the great deep.

He clave the hard rocks in the wilderness : and gave them drink thereof, as it had been out of the great depth.

Psalm 91.title: Psalm 91
Psalm 91.prayer: O God, our refuge and our fortress, defend us from all terror by night and day; keep us beneath the shadow of your wings, in the company of your angels; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Those who dwell in the shelter of the Most High * abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
They shall say to the Lord, “My refuge and my stronghold, * my God in whom I put my trust.”
God’s pinions will cover you, and you will find refuge under God’s wings; * the faithfulness of the Lord shall be a shield and buckler.
For God shall give the angels charge over you, * to keep you in all your ways.
They shall bear you in their hands, * lest you dash your foot against a stone.

For he shall give his angels charge over thee : to keep thee in all thy ways.
They shall bear thee in their hands : that thou hurt not thy foot against a stone.

Psalm 144.title: Psalm 144
Psalm 144.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 144, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Blessed be the Lord my rock! * happy are the people whose God is the Lord!
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

versesBAS.text: Blessed be the Lord my rock! * happy are the people whose God is the Lord!

versesCoverdale.text: Blessed be the Lord my strength : who teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight;
For thy loving-kindness is ever before mine eyes : and I will walk in thy truth.
O deliver thy people, and bless thine inheritance : govern them, and lift them up for ever.

Psalm 145.title: Psalm 145
Psalm 145.prayer: Generous God, your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom and your compassion is over all your works; fill our mouths with your praise from age to age; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: I will exalt you, O God my Sovereign, * and bless your name for ever and ever.
Every day will I bless you * and praise your name for ever and ever.
Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised; * there is no end to the greatness of God.
The Lord is gracious and full of compassion, * slow to anger and of great kindness.
The Lord is loving to everyone, * and God’s compassion is over all the Lord’s works.

versesBAS.text: I will exalt you, O God my King, * and bless your name for ever and ever.
Every day will I bless you * and praise your name for ever and ever.
Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised; * there is no end to his greatness.
The Lord is gracious and full of compassion, * slow to anger and of great kindness.
The Lord is loving to everyone, * and his compassion is over all his works.

versesCoverdale.text: I will magnify thee, O God, my King : and I will praise thy Name for ever and ever.
Every day will I give thanks unto thee : and praise thy Name for ever and ever.
Great is the Lord, and marvellous worthy to be praised : there is no end of his greatness.
The Lord is gracious, and merciful : long-suffering, and of great goodness.
The Lord is loving unto every man : and his mercy is over all his works.

Psalm 146.title: Psalm 146
Psalm 146.prayer: Almighty and everliving God, as we pray the words of Psalm 146, incline our hearts to trust in your steadfast mercy and walk in the light of your truth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord, O my soul! * I will praise the Lord as long as I live; the Lord sets the prisoners free and opens the eyes of the blind.
For the steadfast love of the Lord endures from age to age, * and God’s faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Deliver your people, O God of our salvation, * and lead us in the paths of righteousness for your name’s sake.

versesCoverdale.text: Praise the Lord, O my soul; while I live will I praise the Lord : yea, as long as I have any being, I will sing praises unto my God.
For thy loving-kindness is ever before mine eyes : and I will walk in thy truth.
O deliver thy people, and bless thine inheritance : govern them, and lift them up for ever.

Psalm 150.title: Psalm 150
Psalm 150.prayer: God of all creation, fill every breath within us with your praise, that we may join the choir of heaven and earth in magnifying your holy name; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

versesInclusive.text: Hallelujah! Praise God in the holy temple; * praise God in the firmament of power.
Praise the Lord for mighty acts; * praise God for abundant greatness.
Praise the Lord with the blast of the ram’s-horn; * praise God with lyre and harp.
Let everything that has breath * praise the Lord. Hallelujah!

versesBAS.text: Hallelujah! Praise God in his holy temple; * praise him in the firmament of his power.
Praise him for his mighty acts; * praise him for his excellent greatness.
Praise him with the blast of the ram’s-horn; * praise him with lyre and harp.
Let everything that has breath * praise the Lord. Hallelujah!

versesCoverdale.text: O praise God in his holiness : praise him in the firmament of his power.
Praise him in his noble acts : praise him according to his excellent greatness.
Praise him in the sound of the trumpet : praise him upon the lute and harp.
Let every thing that hath breath : praise the Lord.
